def testPushoutEquiv
    {R A₁ A₂ B₁ B₂ C₁ C₂ : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A₁] [CommRing A₂]
    [CommRing B₁] [CommRing B₂] [CommRing C₁] [CommRing C₂]
    [Algebra R A₁] [Algebra R A₂]
    [Algebra R B₁] [Algebra R B₂] [Algebra R C₁] [Algebra R C₂]
    (f₁ : A₁ →ₐ[R] B₁) (g₁ : A₁ →ₐ[R] C₁)
    (f₂ : A₂ →ₐ[R] B₂) (g₂ : A₂ →ₐ[R] C₂)
    (eA : A₁ ≃ₐ[R] A₂) (eB : B₁ ≃ₐ[R] B₂) (eC : C₁ ≃ₐ[R] C₂)
    (hf : eB.toAlgHom.comp f₁ = f₂.comp eA.toAlgHom)
    (hg : eC.toAlgHom.comp g₁ = g₂.comp eA.toAlgHom) :
    Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₁ g₁ ≃ₐ[R]
      Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing f₂ g₂ := by
  dsimp only [Pic0FiniteStageTensorPushoutRing]
  letI : Algebra A₁ B₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₁
  letI : Algebra A₁ C₁ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap g₁
  letI : Algebra A₂ B₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap f₂
  letI : Algebra A₂ C₂ := pic0FiniteStageAlgebraOfMap g₂
  letI : IsScalarTower R A₁ B₁ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₁
  letI : IsScalarTower R A₂ B₂ := pic0FiniteStageTowerOfMap f₂
  let P₁ := B₁ ⊗[A₁] C₁
  let P₂ := B₂ ⊗[A₂] C₂
  let jB : B₁ →+* P₂ :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp eB.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  let jC : C₁ →+* P₂ :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom.comp eC.toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  have ht : IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f₁.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g₁.toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom jB) (CommRingCat.ofHom jC) := by
    apply (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A₂ B₂ C₂).of_iso'
      eA.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso eB.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso
      eC.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso (Iso.refl (CommRingCat.of P₂))
    · ext x
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hf.symm x
    · ext x
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hg.symm x
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have hs : IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom f₁.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom g₁.toRingHom)
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

      (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
        (R := A₁) (A := B₁) (B := C₁)).toRingHom) :=
    CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct A₁ B₁ C₁
  let ie : CommRingCat.of P₁ ≅ CommRingCat.of P₂ :=
    hs.isoIsPushout (CommRingCat.of B₁) (CommRingCat.of C₁) ht
  let e : P₁ ≃+* P₂ := ie.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  refine AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) fun x => ?_
  have hleft := hs.inl_isoIsPushout_hom (CommRingCat.of B₁) (CommRingCat.of C₁) ht
  have hx := congrArg
    (fun q : CommRingCat.of B₁ ⟶ CommRingCat.of P₂ => q.hom ((algebraMap R B₁) x))
    hleft
  change ie.hom.hom (((algebraMap R B₁) x) ⊗ₜ[A₁] 1) =
    jB ((algebraMap R B₁) x) at hx
  change ie.hom.hom (((algebraMap R B₁) x) ⊗ₜ[A₁] 1) =
    ((algebraMap R B₂) x) ⊗ₜ[A₂] 1
  rw [← eB.commutes x]
  exact hx

#check testPushoutEquiv
end
end AlgebraicGeometry
